item.title: Coyote vs. Acme is even funnier because Warner Bros. Discovery tried to kill it
item.summary: There's an argument to be made that people wouldn't be all that interested in Coyote vs. Acme if it weren't for the way David Zaslav tried to kill it. By trying to shelve the project, Warner Bros. Discovery only drew attention to its habit of disappearing nearly completed movies in order to cash in on […]
